intent: Page navigation with previous, next, page numbers, and ellipsis. Not ButtonGroup. Not Tabs.
doNotUseWhen: a pair of sibling actions — ButtonGroup

compact.note: Narrow layout for small screens: icon-only Previous and Next ("Previous page", "Next page") around a "2 of 10" status. Ignores showPages and showLabels. The default layout wraps instead of overflowing.

page.note: controlled 1-based. Controlled when page is a number.

showPages.note: false shows Previous/Next only (icons-only when showLabels is also false)

showLabels.note: Previous / Next text next to chevrons. Icon-only uses ariaLabel.

showPreviousNext.note: false hides Previous/Next (Simple: page numbers only)

passthrough.note: aria-label defaults to "Pagination" and can be overridden.

requirements: current page uses kit Button appearance=outline mode=neutral and aria-current=page
ellipsis is a span with Lucide Ellipsis, aria-hidden, not a Button
compact: the status shows "2 of 10" (pageOf, aria-hidden) and reads "Page 2 of 10" (pageStatus, visually hidden) in an aria-live=polite span
built-in labels (previous, next, previousPage, nextPage, pageOf, pageStatus) come from KitLabelsProvider; English by default

doNot: do not use ButtonGroup for paging
